# Objective

Cut v0.4.0 so the published artifact carries the four unreleased output
features. Minor bump: new user-visible outputs, additive schemas, no
breaking change — the v0.2.0/v0.3.0 precedent.

# Scope — what ships in v0.4.0

1. `63f8a48` qc-summary strand columns (15 → 18-column digest).
2. `91fbc63` `--length-dist-out` read_len/dm distributions (primary-only).
3. `4c6bb39` `smoothed_deletion` (needs `--fasta`; null without).
4. `c371d52` `total` + 8 rate columns in error.parquet (9 → 19 columns;
   samtools depth -J parity test). Plus `3f767ca` (dev-env samtools).

# Planned steps (as-built: executed as planned, 2026-10-20)

1. Bumped `0.3.0` → `0.4.0` in the three files.
2. Verified `sam-tagger --version` → 0.4.0 before committing.
3. Commit `506574b` `chore(release): bump version to 0.4.0`.
4. Annotated tag `v0.4.0` pushed with `main` (`269168a..506574b`);
   `release.yml` triggered on the tag.
5. GitHub Release created with curated notes: four features, `--fasta`
   requirement, parity conditions, additive-schema upgrade notes.
6. Workflow watched to conclusion: run `39444128908` — success; assets
   `sam_tagger-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl` + `sam_tagger-0.4.0.tar.gz`
   attached; release marked Latest.
7. Report at [20261020-225926](20261020-225926_release-v0.4.0.report.qmd);
   audit and rolling state updated.

# Risks

- Push publishes nine commits at once (four features + docs) — all verified
  green this session (150 tests at HEAD).
- Release notes must state the `--fasta` and parity conditions so consumers
  are not surprised by null columns or universe differences.

# Verification criteria

1. `sam-tagger --version` → 0.4.0.
2. Tag `v0.4.0` pushed; release workflow concludes success; artifacts
   attached to the GitHub Release.
3. Release page shows the curated notes.
